name: Flame Lance
primary:
A searing beam of flame.
A beam to the aim point hits everyone along it. In instant mode it keeps firing while held. Effects:
• Damage 2.75 ❤ fire (fire ×0.5 on wet)
• Heat: sets on fire for 18 s (wet targets just dry off), thaws; melts ice and burns roots
